gaps.title: IoT modules have zero cross-module imports
gaps.description: sensor_placement, context_broker, smart_models, data_pipeline, device_management, data_validation are completely isolated. No data flows from IoT to decision_support or digital_twin.
gaps.impact: Sensor data never reaches decision engine or digital twin. System is a collection of independent tools, not a unified platform.
gaps.recommended_fix: Create src/iot/iot_orchestrator.py that subscribes to data_pipeline events and publishes to event_bus

gaps.title: Digital twin modules have zero cross-module imports
gaps.description: simulator, knowledge_graph, ontology, water_balance, nutrient_cycling, graph_algorithms are isolated. Simulation results never trigger recommendations.
gaps.impact: Digital twin is a standalone simulation tool, not connected to the decision loop.
gaps.recommended_fix: Create src/digital_twin/twin_orchestrator.py that publishes simulation results to event_bus

gaps.title: Genomics modules have zero cross-module imports
gaps.description: crispr and protein modules are isolated. No connection to knowledge_graph or decision_support.
gaps.impact: Genomic analysis results never inform crop recommendations or knowledge graph.
gaps.recommended_fix: Create src/genomics/genomics_orchestrator.py that publishes to knowledge_graph and event_bus

gaps.title: Multi-agent modules have zero cross-module imports
gaps.description: swarm, consensus, task_allocation, fault_tolerance, collision_avoidance are isolated. No connection to optimization or decision_support.
gaps.impact: Multi-agent coordination cannot trigger optimization or receive tasks from decision engine.
gaps.recommended_fix: Create src/multi_agent/agent_orchestrator.py that subscribes to event_bus and calls unified_optimizer

gaps.title: Onboarding modules have zero cross-module imports
gaps.description: sizing and modules are isolated. No connection to any other module.
gaps.impact: Onboarding cannot validate that recommended modules actually work together.
gaps.recommended_fix: Add validation in ModuleRegistry that imports and smoke-tests each recommended module

gaps.title: Integration modules have zero cross-module imports
gaps.description: event_bus and farm_state are isolated. No other module imports them.
gaps.impact: Event bus is defined but never used. FarmState validation exists but is never called.
gaps.recommended_fix: Wire event_bus into all module orchestrators. Use FarmState in decision_support endpoints.

gaps.title: Event bus is defined but never used
gaps.description: EventBus class exists with pub/sub, but zero modules publish or subscribe to it.
gaps.impact: No event-driven communication between modules. System is request-response only.
gaps.recommended_fix: Create orchestrator modules that publish domain events (SensorDataReceived, SimulationComplete, AlertTriggered)

gaps.title: Alerts never reach dashboard or API
gaps.description: AlertManager creates alerts but they are never published to dashboard or API gateway.
gaps.impact: Users cannot see alerts in real-time dashboard or query them via API.

gaps.title: FarmState validation is never called
gaps.description: FarmState has __post_init__ validation but no module uses it. Invalid data flows to DecisionEngine.
gaps.impact: Invalid sensor data (negative moisture, extreme temperature) reaches decision engine unchecked.
gaps.recommended_fix: Use FarmState in api_gateway endpoints and iot_orchestrator

gaps.title: Data validation is never invoked
gaps.description: SchemaValidator and AnomalyDetector exist but no module calls them.
gaps.impact: Invalid or anomalous sensor data is stored and processed without checks.
gaps.recommended_fix: Call SchemaValidator in data_pipeline MQTTClient and KafkaStream

gaps.title: API gateway only exposes recommender
gaps.description: API gateway has endpoints for tenants, farms, sensor readings, and recommendations. No endpoints for optimization, genomics, or multi-agent.
gaps.impact: External systems cannot trigger optimization or query genomics results via API.

gaps.title: No WebSocket endpoint for real-time data
gaps.description: Dashboard supports WebSocket but API gateway does not expose it.
gaps.impact: External systems cannot subscribe to real-time farm data streams.
gaps.recommended_fix: Add /ws/farm/{farm_id} WebSocket endpoint to API gateway

gaps.title: Optimization results never reach decision support
gaps.description: UnifiedOptimizer solves problems but results are never published to event_bus or sent to decision_support.
gaps.impact: Optimization results are computed but never acted upon.

gaps.title: Path planning results never reach multi-agent
gaps.description: CoveragePlanner and ObstacleField compute paths but never send them to swarm or task_allocation.
gaps.impact: Drones and robots cannot receive computed paths.

gaps.title: Digital twin never receives sensor data
gaps.description: SimulationState is created manually, never from IoT sensor data.
gaps.impact: Digital twin is a standalone simulation, not a real-time twin.

gaps.title: Synchronous-only handler invocation blocks publishers
gaps.description: All handlers are invoked synchronously in the publish() call. A slow handler blocks the publisher and all subsequent handlers. No async/await support, no thread pool, no batching mechanism.
gaps.impact: Under load, publishers stall; head-of-line blocking prevents scalable event processing.

gaps.title: No backpressure or flow control
gaps.description: publish() accepts events unconditionally. No queue depth limits, no rate limiting, no backpressure signaling to publishers.
gaps.impact: Memory exhaustion under burst load; no graceful degradation path.

gaps.title: FileEventStore lacks fsync and crash consistency
gaps.description: append() writes to file without fsync(). A crash can lose the last event or corrupt the JSONL file. No write-ahead log, no checksums.
gaps.impact: Data loss on crash; corrupted event store requires manual recovery.

gaps.title: No event store rotation or compaction
gaps.description: FileEventStore grows unbounded. No size-based rotation, no time-based compaction, no archival.
gaps.impact: Disk space exhaustion; slow replay as file grows.

gaps.title: No event TTL or expiration
gaps.description: Events persist forever. No TTL mechanism, no automatic cleanup of stale events.
gaps.impact: Unbounded storage growth; compliance issues with sensitive data.

gaps.title: Exactly-once deduplication is in-memory only
gaps.description: _processed_event_ids is a local set. On restart, all dedup state is lost. Duplicate events will be reprocessed after recovery.
gaps.impact: Exactly-once guarantee violated on restart; duplicate side effects.

gaps.title: No handler timeout mechanism
gaps.description: A handler that hangs indefinitely blocks the entire publish() call. No timeout, no circuit breaker.
gaps.impact: Single hung handler can wedge the event bus.

gaps.title: Dead letter queue has no retry or replay mechanism
gaps.description: Events in DLQ are terminal. No scheduled retry, no manual replay API, no DLQ depth alerting.
gaps.impact: Failed events are silently lost; no operational recovery path.

gaps.title: No event ordering guarantees across types
gaps.description: Events are stored in publish order per type, but no global sequence number or causal ordering across event types.
gaps.impact: Consumers cannot reliably reconstruct cross-module causality.

gaps.title: No wildcard or pattern-based subscriptions
gaps.description: Subscribers must know exact event type strings. No wildcard (e.g., 'sensor.*') or regex-based subscription.
gaps.impact: Tight coupling between publishers and subscribers; harder to add new event types.

gaps.title: No event filtering by source or payload
gaps.description: Subscribers receive all events of a type regardless of source or payload content. No server-side filtering.
gaps.impact: Wasted handler invocations; subscribers must filter client-side.

gaps.title: No metrics or observability hooks
gaps.description: No counters for publish/subscribe/delivery rates, no latency histograms, no export to monitoring systems.
gaps.impact: No visibility into bus health or performance bottlenecks.

gaps.title: No graceful shutdown or drain
gaps.description: No close() or shutdown() method to stop accepting new events and drain in-flight handlers.
gaps.impact: Events lost during application shutdown.

gaps.title: No schema versioning in serialization
gaps.description: to_dict()/from_dict() have no version field. Schema evolution is not supported; old serialized data cannot be migrated.
gaps.impact: Breaking changes to FarmState fields break deserialization of historical data.

gaps.title: tenant_id not serialized in to_dict()
gaps.description: tenant_id is a field on FarmState but is excluded from to_dict(). Multi-tenant deployments lose tenant context on serialization.
gaps.impact: Tenant isolation broken when state is persisted or transmitted.

gaps.title: No cross-field validation rules
gaps.description: Validation is per-field range checks only. No relational rules (e.g., high temperature + low moisture = stress condition).
gaps.impact: Invalid but in-range field combinations accepted; missed anomaly detection.

gaps.title: No partial update support
gaps.description: FarmState requires all fields at construction. No patch/update mechanism for incremental sensor updates.
gaps.impact: Must reconstruct full state for single-field updates; inefficient for high-frequency sensor data.

gaps.title: No field-level metadata (source, confidence, timestamp)
gaps.description: Fields carry no provenance. Cannot distinguish sensor-derived vs. manual-entry values, no confidence intervals.
gaps.impact: Cannot weight or filter data by quality; audit trail incomplete.

gaps.title: No transition history or audit log
gaps.description: StateTransitionValidator checks rules but does not record who/what triggered the transition. No audit trail.
gaps.impact: Cannot reconstruct why state changed; compliance gaps.

gaps.title: No formal state machine pattern
gaps.description: Transitions are validated by ad-hoc rules, not a defined state machine with explicit states and allowed transitions.
gaps.impact: Hard to reason about valid state graphs; rules may conflict or have gaps.

gaps.title: No concurrency control for state updates
gaps.description: No locking, optimistic concurrency, or compare-and-swap. Concurrent updates can lost-update.
gaps.impact: Race conditions in multi-threaded or multi-process deployments.

gaps.title: No bulk import/export
gaps.description: No batch serialization for history. Each state must be serialized individually.
gaps.impact: Inefficient for large-scale data migration or backup.

gaps.title: FarmStateDiff does not track change timestamp
gaps.description: Diff captures field changes but not when the change occurred. Cannot correlate with events.
gaps.impact: Cannot build accurate timeline of state changes.

gaps.title: No anomaly detection on state values
gaps.description: Range validation catches impossible values but not statistically anomalous ones (e.g., sudden spike).
gaps.impact: Sensor faults or extreme events go undetected.

gaps.title: No integration with event bus for state change notifications
gaps.description: FarmState is decoupled from EventBus. State changes do not automatically publish events.
gaps.impact: Other modules cannot react to state changes without polling.

gaps.title: No integration with event bus for optimization lifecycle events
gaps.description: UnifiedOptimizer does not publish events on solve start, completion, or failure. No observability into optimization runs.
gaps.impact: Cannot monitor or audit optimization; no event-driven chaining.

gaps.title: No integration with farm state for problem context
gaps.description: OptimizationProblem does not reference FarmState. Cannot automatically populate routing problems from current farm conditions.
gaps.impact: Manual problem construction required; no context-aware optimization.

gaps.title: No problem validation before solving
gaps.description: solve() does not validate that required fields are present for the chosen solver_type. Errors surface deep in solver internals.
gaps.impact: Poor error messages; hard to debug misconfigured problems.

gaps.title: No solver auto-selection heuristics
gaps.description: Caller must specify solver_type explicitly. No logic to choose optimal solver based on problem size, constraints, or hardware.
gaps.impact: Suboptimal solver selection; requires caller expertise.

gaps.title: No async support for long-running optimizations
gaps.description: solve() is synchronous. Large problems block the caller with no progress callbacks or cancellation.
gaps.impact: Cannot run optimizations in background; no progress visibility.

gaps.title: No result caching
gaps.description: Identical problems are re-solved from scratch. No memoization or cache layer.
gaps.impact: Wasted computation for repeated or similar problems.

gaps.title: No timeout handling
gaps.description: No timeout parameter on solve(). A pathological problem can run indefinitely.
gaps.impact: Resource exhaustion; no SLA enforcement.

gaps.title: No fallback solver on failure
gaps.description: If the primary solver fails, there is no automatic fallback to a simpler or more robust algorithm.
gaps.impact: Single point of failure; no graceful degradation.

gaps.title: No support for time windows (VRPTW)
gaps.description: VRP solver does not support time window constraints. Real-world routing often requires delivery time windows.
gaps.impact: Cannot model time-sensitive deliveries; limits applicability.

gaps.title: No multi-objective optimization support
gaps.description: Only single-objective cost minimization. No support for balancing cost, time, fuel, or fairness.
gaps.impact: Cannot model real-world trade-offs.

gaps.title: No solver health checking or capability discovery
gaps.description: No way to query which solvers are available, their capabilities, or their health status.
gaps.impact: Cannot build adaptive systems that select solvers based on availability.

gaps.title: No result persistence
gaps.description: OptimizationResult is returned in-memory only. No integration with event store or database for audit.
gaps.impact: Cannot replay or analyze past optimizations.

key_finding: Only 7 cross-module imports exist across 43 source files. The system is a collection of independent tools, not a unified platform. The event_bus, farm_state, and unified_optimizer are defined but never used by other modules. Orchestrator modules are needed to wire everything together. Event bus has no async support, no crash-safe persistence, and no backpressure. FarmState lacks schema versioning and event integration. UnifiedOptimizer has no event bus integration, no validation, and no async/timeout support.
